Thanks again for the time last week. Attached is a working MAP and a draft SOW (see Acme_MAP_v2.xlsx, SOW-Acme-Draft.pdf). Before we lock the evaluation cadence, I want to confirm two things we discussed:

1) Executive liaison / EB seat: who will be your executive sponsor (single point at VP+) and who should sit in the executive briefing (EB) meetings? We usually ask for: sponsor (VP+), product owner, procurement lead (optional), and security lead for the second meeting.

2) Proposed EB kickoff window: the week of Oct 4 — we can do a 60-minute kickoff (internal + execs) followed by a narrower technical evaluation sync the following week.

Can you confirm names/titles for the sponsor and the two recommended EB delegates? If the sponsor prefers not to attend the kickoff, we can do an abbreviated sponsor briefing (20 min) the same week.

I copied Rishi and Connor to own the internal MAP milestones and Marcus to track procurement redlines. If you prefer a different meeting cadence, tell us and we’ll adapt.
